premise: First representative slice of Sphirus World in the existing Unreal project: leave the lived-in house, cross the yard, go down to the pond, start up the rear forest trail.

loop.goal: observed (project): day stations - bed, wardrobe, tea, mask bench, wood, hearth - are the existing loop; this pass adds no mechanic.
loop.success: authored for this pass: the slice route is walkable with the saved player and reads as one identity from the gameplay camera.
loop.failure_or_pressure: none in this slice (exploration); fatigue only lowers pace.
loop.restart: PIE restart / Story Framework save-load; the user slot is never written by tests (sha1 checked per run).
